purpose: Interface and functional acceptance; not a quality comparison or a complete benchmark run

scope.tool_module: T0 on/off, frozen r8/r12 protocol; CUDA and NPU entry points share the paper source
scope.native_recovery: Shared tool wrapper retains tool representation across draft and recovery generation
scope.text_budget_definition: Fixed actor-history capacity; independent of observed C2KV occupancy and auxiliary compression cost
excluded_combinations: H2O/SnapKV compression of the tool region itself

paper_merged_targeted.scope: Paper routing, budgets, native arm identity, replay, raw source recording, adapters, atomic prepare and worker ownership

engine_final_targeted.scope: T0 composition, persistent history, handle/position contracts, native sampling, whole denominator and telemetry

native_runtime_final_targeted.scope: Native server, tool wrapper, real-engine handle contract, ACE transport, inline anchors and physical KV cost finalization

paper_native_finalization_targeted.scope: ACE arm binding and final cost acceptance for closed-loop and replay

paper_default_ace_matrix_targeted.scope: Default C1 r8/r4 ACE cells, candidate overlays, budgets and tool contexts

paper_final_combined.scope: Final c1, native_extra, runner, candidate, text-budget and tool-context suites

earlier_off_cuda_equivalence.scope: Full and H2O on one official BFCL task before the concurrent upstream audit merge; no universal score invariance claim

t0_serving_weights.conversion: serving tensor subset; no dtype/value changes

limitations: All official task scores are preliminary, n=1 functional smokes; no method-strength conclusion is supported.
The final native whole-prompt denominator comes from the bound native Full renderer; earlier native T0 snapshots are not whole-prompt compression measurements.
Failed interface attempts and the helper-only encoder_chunks classification error remain in their original artifact directories.
AppWorld and ToolSandbox source/transport combinations have CPU coverage; no AppWorld/ToolSandbox CUDA end-to-end run is claimed here.
NPU was checked at CPU/launcher boundaries only, as requested.
Original production jobs, benchmark artifacts, unrelated working-tree files and stash entries were not replaced.
